panels.description: Ada reaches for the archive terminal; Leona stops her hand. Leave upper terminal space.
The public archive opens to a recorded emergency vote: Leona, Adrian and Mera beside the three bands while damaged reservoirs and locked stores appear behind them. Leave upper archive space.
Adrian's band remains dark while Mera's band glows. Keep both bands clear.
Leona places her hand on the deciding record and accepts the public archive. Leave upper space.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: If I open it, it stays open.
